data.name: Naiara
data.gender_notes: Naiara is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Basque word 'Nai', meaning 'water'. In the Bible, Naara is not a known name. However, it has a gentle, flowing, and soothing meaning, making it an excellent choice for a little girl. The name Naiara carries the meaning “Gentle Flow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Naiara usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by nature, symbolizing the gentle flow of life and the peaceful nurturing of the soul.
data.etymology: Naiara belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Flow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naiara total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
